001package org.clafer.ir;
002
003import org.clafer.common.Check;
004import org.clafer.domain.Domain;
005
006/**
007 * dividend / divisor
008 * 
009 * @author jimmy
010 */
011public class IrDiv extends IrAbstractInt {
012
013    /**
014     * Division is internally represented as a binary operation unlike
015     * addition and subtraction. The reason is that this makes optimizing for
016     * Choco easier.
017     */
018    private final IrIntExpr dividend, divisor;
019
020    IrDiv(IrIntExpr dividend, IrIntExpr divisor, Domain domain) {
021        super(domain);
022        this.dividend = Check.notNull(dividend);
023        this.divisor = Check.notNull(divisor);
024    }
025
026    public IrIntExpr getDividend() {
027        return dividend;
028    }
029
030    public IrIntExpr getDivisor() {
031        return divisor;
032    }
033
034    @Override
035    public <A, B> B accept(IrIntExprVisitor< A, B> visitor, A a) {
036        return visitor.visit(this, a);
037    }
038
039    @Override
040    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
041        if (obj instanceof IrDiv) {
042            IrDiv other = (IrDiv) obj;
043            return dividend.equals(other.dividend) && divisor.equals(other.divisor);
044        }
045        return false;
046    }
047
048    @Override
049    public int hashCode() {
050        return dividend.hashCode() ^ divisor.hashCode();
051    }
052
053    @Override
054    public String toString() {
055        return "(" + dividend + ") / (" + divisor + ")";
056    }
057}
